metadata.description: Honest, ATS-safe job hunting with Claude in two editions: Pro (Claude Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise) and Free (Claude Free plus a local open-source engine).

plugins.name: job-hunter-pro
plugins.description: Pro edition, for Claude Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise. Verifies every job link in a real browser (Claude in Chrome or the desktop app's built-in browser), tracks applications from Gmail and runs as scheduled tasks.

plugins.name: job-hunter-free
plugins.description: Free edition, for the Claude Free plan. A small open-source engine on your own computer finds jobs through public ATS APIs, checks links with a headless browser, reads your inbox over IMAP and runs on your computer's own scheduler.
